g.text: Fixed testing capacity: 10 features/day. Uniform arrivals: 8–12 features/day.

g.text: Development cost: €1,000.00 per feature. Equal test effort. Empty queue at the start.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #19382c

g.text: Individual queues can empty again. The expected backlog does not settle.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #697971

g.text: Shading shows variability between queues, not uncertainty in the mean. Synthetic model, not company data.
